Boi canh: repo task-manager (D:\coding\personal-tools\task-manager), nhanh refactor/tach-module-fe-db
(chua merge vao main). Day la phien REVIEW CODE THAT (khong ban lai thiet ke) tren 3 commit da trien
khai dung theo ke hoach da hoi tu qua phien Council thiet ke truoc (run 022dd1e5, xem
docs/exchanges/2026-09-12.md vong 1-3) - chi kiem tra viec trien khai co dung y do thiet ke khong,
KHONG duoc mo lai quyet dinh kien truc da chot (vd co nen tach thanh 8 file schema hay khong, co nen
ManHinhTaskCaNhan luon mount hay khong - da chot roi).

3 commit can doc that qua git show/git diff (khong doan):
- cbf7fc1f: tach server/db.ts (996 dong) thanh 8 file server/schema/*.ts + server/db-migrations.ts +
  server/db-seed.ts.
- ace16561: tach man Cai dat (settings.tsx + luyen-de-category.tsx) khoi src/main.tsx.
- 7d00f32f: tach man Task ca nhan (personal-task.tsx, 1843 dong) khoi src/main.tsx - buoc rui ro cao
  nhat, co ref-handle moi { openQuickAdd, openHistory, refresh(date?) } va prop { active,
  notificationPermission }.

Doc truoc: docs/exchanges/2026-09-12.md tu dong "Thiet ke tach module FE + schema DB" (run 022dd1e5,
3 vong) de biet chinh xac thiet ke da chot gi, tranh ban lai.

Yeu cau cu the cho Council (review code that, doc qua git show/git diff):

1. `git show cbf7fc1f --stat` roi doc ky server/db.ts moi + tung file server/schema/*.ts +
   server/db-migrations.ts + server/db-seed.ts:
   - Xac nhan noi dung SQL o moi file schema la GIU NGUYEN VAN tu server/db.ts cu (khong bi doi/thieu
     cot nao) - doi chieu voi `git show b98e91d2:server/db.ts` hoac tuong duong (commit truoc khi tach,
     co the dung `git log --all` de tim commit db.ts truoc khi tach neu can) de so sanh tung bang.
   - Xac nhan thu tu goi 8 ham applyXSchema trong db.ts moi khong pha khoa ngoai noi bo (project:
     projects->project_tasks->project_task_assignments; luyen de: chuoi de_thi_*).
   - Xac nhan emergency_release_batches da dươc doi tu vung migration sang applyReleaseSchema dung nhu
     quyet dinh (khong con o server/db-migrations.ts).
   - Xac nhan server/db-migrations.ts (runLegacyMigrations, runVersionedMigrations) giu dung thu tu va
     noi dung so voi ban cu, dac biet archiveAndDropAutomationSchema() (tu CR truoc) khong bi doi logic.
   - Xac nhan db.ts moi goi dung thu tu: 8 schema -> runLegacyMigrations -> runSeed -> runVersionedMigrations.

2. `git show ace16561 --stat` roi doc src/screens/settings.tsx, src/screens/luyen-de-category.tsx,
   diff cua src/main.tsx:
   - Xac nhan noi dung 4 man (ManHinhQuanLyDanhMuc, ManHinhQuanLyPic, ManHinhCauHinhRedmine,
     ManHinhQuanLyCategory) giu nguyen van, khong sot logic nao trong main.tsx cu.
   - Xac nhan main.tsx khong con import thua nao lien quan tot cac man da chuyen.

3. `git show 7d00f32f --stat` roi doc TOAN VAN src/screens/personal-task.tsx (1843 dong) va diff cua
   src/main.tsx - day la phan quan trong nhat can soi ky:
   - Xac nhan TOAN BO logic (state, effect, ham) chuyen tu App() sang ManHinhTaskCaNhan la giu nguyen
     van, khong sot, khong doi hanh vi.
   - Xac nhan ref-handle { openQuickAdd, openHistory, refresh(date?) } dung y thiet ke da chot (xem
     vong 3 cua phien thiet ke) - dac biet method `refresh` co mot comment giai thich no CO Y khong
     forward tham so `date` cho taiDuLieu, vi day la hanh vi HIEN TAI cua code truoc khi tach (khong
     phai loi moi tu boc tach) - doc ky comment nay va xac nhan dung la hanh vi cu (kiem tra lai bang
     git show tren commit truoc khi tach, vd tim dong `onTasksCreated={() => taiDuLieu().then(() => {})}`
     trong lich su main.tsx) chu khong phai claude tu bia ra de bien minh cho mot loi that.
   - Xac nhan prop `active` chi gate dung phan luoi 3 cot (CotTask x2 + CotDinhKy), con banner tai du
     lieu + toan bo popup KHONG bi gate theo active - dung nhu quyet dinh giu nguyen hanh vi cu (cac
     phan nay truoc day cung khong bi gate theo tabDangMo).
   - Xac nhan main.tsx (con lai 229 dong) that su la app-shell thuan: khong con state/logic nghiep vu
     Task ca nhan nao sot lai.
   - Kiem tra ky moi lien ket (import) giua main.tsx va personal-task.tsx: co dung khong, co thieu gi
     khong (specific: kiem tra `supportsBrowserNotifications` co code trung lap CO CHU Y o CA HAI file -
     day la quyet dinh co ghi trong code, khong phai loi copy-paste vo tinh).

4. Kiem tra test/client/components.test.tsx da duoc sua import CotDinhKy tu vi tri moi dung chua.

5. Neu tim thay bug/thieu sot THAT (khac voi y kien thiet ke da chot), liet ke cu the: file, dong, van
   de, cach sua de xuat. Dac biet chu y: co function/bien nao bi bo sot khi tach (khai bao o 1 file
   nhung dung o file kia) khong; co import nao thua/thieu khong; co JSX nao bi lech logic dieu kien
   khi tach (vi du dieu kien active vs tabDangMo cu) khong.

6. Da co bang chung xac thuc rieng (khong phai chi doc code): tsc sach, 57/57 test frontend + test
   backend xanh, `npm run check` 10/10 cong xanh, va SMOKE TEST PLAYWRIGHT THAT tren ca phien dev
   dang chay LAN tren exe da dong goi - xac nhan: 3 cot Task hien dung, popup Them nhanh/Lich su mo
   dung qua click UI VA qua phim tat Ctrl+Q (kiem chung ref-handle that), chuyen tab roi quay lai van
   con state (always-mounted), tat ca 7 tab deu tai duoc khong loi console, va mot vong tao/lam moi
   task that qua API tren 1 instance DB co lap (khong dung du lieu that cua nguoi dung) xac nhan dung.
   Council co the tin cac bang chung nay la that (da chay, khong phai claude tu ke), nhung van nen tu
   doc code de xac nhan logic dung, khong chi dua vao ket qua test.

7. Neu khong tim thay gi nghiem trong, ky "khong phan doi" kem pham vi da soi (dung R-CRIT - khong
   duoc khen suong, phai neu ro da doc nhung gi).

8. KHONG duoc tu sua code trong phien nay - day la phien REVIEW, ket qua la danh sach phat hien (neu
   co) de dev sua sau.
